parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instance Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must pass the ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Instance Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to pass this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the topic category to be created belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The custom category name of the topic category.

The topic format must use `/` to separate each category in a hierarchy. The category name can contain only letters, digits, and underscores (_). Each category level cannot be empty.

You can use the wildcards `+` and `#` to customize a topic category only when Operation is set to SUB (subscribe). This allows devices to subscribe to topics in batches. For more information about how to use wildcards, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html.

For cloud gateway products, the topic category is fully customized by users. You can use the `${deviceName}` wildcard to represent the DeviceName.
For non-cloud gateway products, the first three levels of a custom topic category are fixed as `/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/`. Specifying TopicShortName completes the topic category
parameters.help_zh:
设置Topic类的自定义类目名称。

Topic格式必须以`/`进行分层，区分每个类目。类目命名只能包含字母、数字和下划线（_），每级类目不能为空。

Operation为SUB（订阅）时，才可以使用通配符`+`和`#`自定义Topic类，以便设备实现批量订阅Topic。通配符使用方法请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85539.html 。

对于云网关产品，Topic类完全由用户自定义输入。支持使用`${deviceName}`通配DeviceName。
对于非云网关产品，自定义Topic类前三个类目已固定为`/${productKey}/${deviceName}/user/`，定义TopicShortName将Topic类填充完整
parameters.name: topic_short_name

parameters.help_en:
The operation permissions that the device has on the topic category. Valid values:

SUB: subscribe.
PUB: publish.
ALL: publish and subscribe
parameters.help_zh:
设备对该Topic类的操作权限，取值：

SUB：订阅。
PUB：发布。
ALL：发布和订阅
parameters.name: operation

parameters.help_en: The description of the topic category. The description can be up to 100 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: Topic类的描述信息。长度限制为100字符（一个中文汉字占一个字符）
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable proxy subscription when Operation is set to SUB (subscribe) or ALL (publish and subscribe). Valid values:

true: enables proxy subscription.
false: does not enable proxy subscription.

After proxy subscription is enabled, when a device connects to IoT Platform, IoT Platform queries the topics for which proxy subscription is enabled and helps the device complete the subscription
parameters.help_zh:
Operation为SUB（订阅）或ALL（发布和订阅），可开启代理订阅。
取值：

true：开启。
false：不开启。

开启代理订阅后，设备与物联网平台建连时，物联网平台查询已开启代理订阅的Topic，帮助设备完成订阅
parameters.name: enable_proxy_subscribe

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable data compression or decompression for custom topics in a Dedicated Enterprise Edition instance. Valid values:

compress: compression.
decompress: decompression.

For more information about the data compression feature, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html.

<notice>If TopicShortName contains wildcards (`+` and `#`), you cannot specify Codec at the same time. If you enable data compression or decompression while creating a topic category with wildcards, the request to invoke this API operation to create the topic category will fail.
</notice>
parameters.help_zh:
尊享型企业版实例下，可开启自定义Topic数据压缩或解压缩。
取值：

compress：压缩。
decompress：解压缩。

数据压缩功能详细内容，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/477405.html。

<notice>TopicShortName传入通配符（`+`和`#`）时，不可同时传入Codec。如果创建通配Topic类的同时，开启了数据压缩或解压缩功能，调用本接口创建该Topic类会失败。
</notice>
parameters.name: codec
